what: The best action coverage each live scenario has shown over the surface it could address, and the published actions a farm fixture cannot reach.
howRead: tools/live-run/analysis/action-breadth.mjs --result <bundle>; attempted actions against the run's own published `snapshotCensus` (the families its snapshots carried a row for), joined to actions through tools/lib/stardew-published-action-registry.mjs and TARGET_FIELD
why: A count of executions cannot tell a varied day from 124 repetitions of three safe actions. `round39` reported
`executionTrace: { ok: true, rows: 124 }` and completed, having addressed a small part of the world it was
given, and nothing in its artifact said so. This file is the ratchet that makes the next such run visible: a
run below the recorded best is `narrow:below_baseline:<label>`.
THE DENOMINATOR. Coverage is `attempted / addressable`, never `attempted / 95`: a target-bound action is only
constructible while its `*Targets` family has a row in the snapshot, one `FixtureScenario` arms one world, and
the first version of this ratchet therefore charged the companion for the fixture's world. `addressable` is what
the run's own census allowed, so a different fixture scenario cannot make the ratchet lie.
WHAT IS NOT HERE. `addressable` is null on the entry below on purpose: `round38`'s bundle publishes no census,
so its addressable width is not a number this gate ever measured, and the ratchet every later run is compared
against must not rest on a figure derived outside the gate. Its attempted count (24) and family count (11) were
measured against the catalog and are kept as context; only the family count is compared until a census-bearing

multiday_routine.label: round38
multiday_routine.measured: 24 distinct actions in 11 families over 379 executions, largest single action 22% (break_rock) - the widest multiday day on this machine out of the 172 multiday bundles that carry an attempted list
multiday_routine.addressableNotRecorded: this bundle predates `snapshotCensus`, so the gate measures it as not_measured:no_snapshot_census and records no width for it; the first census-bearing multiday run sets `addressable` here

exclusions.reason: elevator-floor action: the floor set is not a client-supplied range, it is what `MineElevatorMenu` displays (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Models/BridgeProtocolModels.cs:483-497), so a fixture that has never descended a mine publishes no floor to select and the current floor is a native no-op

multiplayer-only: the one social act that is not about an NPC in front of the actor, sent to the whole lobby through `Multiplayer.sendChatMessage` (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Policy/FarmhandActionDefinitions.cs:586-589); a native-local farm fixture has one farmhand and no peer to reach

needs a Raft in a tool slot (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Policy/FarmhandActionDefinitions.cs:285, `ToolResource("raft", ...)`) and open water beside it; the native-local fixture's player starts with no raft and no farm day places one

targets the Bus Stop ticket machine of the current location (integrations/stardew/src/Core/Protocol/BridgeProtocol.cs:2094-2096) and drives `BusStop.checkAction+answerDialogue` (FarmhandActionDefinitions.cs:272-283); the bus is out of order until the Vault repair, which a fixture that starts a fresh farm has not done
